purpose: Lightweight deterministic Night City stock ebb-and-flow layered inside persistent shop refresh cycles.
stock_day: UTC day number; deterministic and shared across public-2045
target_daily_mutations: approximately 40–70 across the current visible Night City stock surface

actions.ambient_sale: 60% of selected mutations; decreases a finite quantity
actions.delivery: 25% of selected mutations; raises a finite quantity, capped around 150% of generated baseline
actions.sellout: 8% of selected mutations; temporarily takes the line to zero
actions.replenishment: 7% of selected mutations; moves stock back toward generated baseline

constraints: Does not alter the shop assortment.
Major assortment turnover remains controlled by each shop's stock lifecycle cadence.
Player or future user purchases are stored separately as persistent depletion deltas.
Ambient supply can increase effective current capacity without deleting persistent player depletion.

persistence_policy.principle: The simulation is reconstructable; only deliberate world-state deviations are recorded.

note: Retained only as design history. Vend-R no longer replays or derives daily citywide pulses; shop stock now advances lazily when a shop profile is observed.
